title: The Glance at the Corridor
continuityFrom: EP02 Meenakshi M12 13:15 — locker disturbed; privately alert; no culprit knowledge; prior teasing during rounds remains part of her mood

beats.title: She isn't quite herself
beats.external: Naveen arrives with ordinary administrative papers. Meenakshi answers more briefly than usual.
beats.internal: She remains uneasy after the locker discovery; Naveen notices her subdued expression without pressing her.

beats.title: An unexpected laugh
beats.external: A familiar work-related exchange turns lightly teasing. Naveen gives an unexpectedly clever reply; Meenakshi genuinely laughs.
beats.internal: She gets a moment of relief; he privately appreciates the smile but does not presume romance.

beats.title: Normal tasks, separate spaces
beats.external: They part for normal duties. Naveen collects another handover copy. Meenakshi briefly visits the staff changing area, removes her white coat and adjusts her existing plum kurta and grey cardigan.
beats.internal: Her earlier locker concern remains unresolved. This is a mid-shift break, not her departure from the hospital.

beats.title: The unexpected glance — cut
beats.external: As Meenakshi gathers her bag, its strap catches her cardigan and briefly shifts the neckline enough to reveal an edge of inner clothing. Naveen reaches the corridor with the handover copy, notices, looks away; Meenakshi catches his glance and adjusts her outfit.
beats.internal: She feels briefly self-conscious while already uneasy about privacy; Naveen is surprised and deliberately avoids prolonged looking. No romantic or physical consent inferred.
beats.cut: STOP at 14:15 before reply, goodbye or follow-on interaction.
